children.text: Nexora is a smart-workforce company uniting talent, AI, and robotics for enterprises across Southeast Asia and global markets. To match a vision that spans humanoids, delivery robots, and warehouse automation, we designed and built a digital experience that makes the future of work feel like it is already here.

Lumina Fintech is an AI loan platform in Malaysia that pairs smart loan matching with fair, explainable AI credit assessment for personal and SME borrowers. From strategy to launch, we designed and built a digital product experience that makes complex lending decisions feel clear, trustworthy, and effortless.

Johor Darul Ta’zim is Malaysia’s most decorated football club, and matchday at the Sultan Ibrahim Stadium is a show in its own right. We created the club’s event-day motion visuals — high-energy LED graphics that run across the stadium surfaces and social channels, from pre-match build-up to the final whistle.

children.text: ~ Genting SkyWorlds · 2025 ~

Antara Bubuya brings playful storytelling to Genting SkyWorlds, one of Malaysia’s busiest theme park destinations. We created the campaign’s key visuals and animated screen content — a family of artwork that keeps its charm everywhere, from towering in-park panels to a phone-sized digital ad.

Supermachine Movers Sdn Bhd has spent more than 40 years relocating and installing heavy machinery across Malaysia and beyond. We designed and built a website with the same qualities as their crews on site — precise, dependable, and quietly impressive — turning an industrial trade into a confident digital presence.
VB ZipBlind wanted a cleaner premium look for product communication while keeping technical information simple for customers and installers.

Canada’s largest online pharmacy needed a digital presence that could scale with its next big move: integrating telehealth alongside its pharmacy platform. Already trusted by thousands of Canadians each month, the goal was to create a unified, credible, and intuitive experience that made managing prescriptions and virtual care effortless.

As the original creators of the “$cashtag”, Stocktwits has been a pioneer in blending social interaction and investing. We partnered with their team to create a reimagined identity that reflects the future of financial culture.
Summer Smash Tennis is Johor Bahru’s premier tennis academy. We served up a new brand and website to help them ace the space.
Panaji bakes the world's fluffiest flatbreads. With a strong retail presence and plans to scale, they had an appetite for a new website that would set the table for future growth.

Pen Name sets the standard for high-impact creative — trusted by names like Tim Ferriss, LeBron James, Arnold Schwarzenegger, and Reid Hoffman. From top-ranked podcasts to iconic brand launches, their work shapes culture at the highest level.
Hark is putting wags into bags, with the only human-grade raw food that's also made with heart-healthy grains and whole ingredients.

Litquidity isn’t just a finance meme account, it’s a media powerhouse with over 2.5 million followers, a booming newsletter (ExecSum), a podcast network, and a syndicate of private investors. As their influence grew, so did the need for a cohesive digital identity that matched the sophistication of their content. That's where we came in.
FreshCap is on a mission to bring medicinal mushroom supplements to the world. We developed a distinct identity that helped take the brand from a small supplier to an 8-figure industry leader.
Montfort Capital is building a future where private credit is accessible to everyone. They needed a bold identity to match their bold vision.

The Salt Spring National Art Prize (SSNAP) is a biennial competition and exhibition of Canadian contemporary art. They needed a bold and engaging website on which to take submissions and showcase exhibitions.
Attribute is a customer attribution app designed for AI Automation. We worked closely with the Attribute team to design the product, along with the brand and website.

is one of the pioneering plant-based supplement companies. They're bringing transparency, quality and a little bit of joy to the industry. As design partner of record, we work together on brand identity, packaging, web design, and ongoing campaigns.
Zoefull is a small Greek brand on a big global mission — to spread joy, health, and long life, through the power of the Mediterranean diet.

As the trusted ingredient supplier for leading supplement brands, Fresh Nutrition knows a thing or two about quality. Now, they're cutting out the middlemen and making premium nutrition more affordable for everyone.

Trends with Friends is a hub for financial insights, trends, and market ideas. Their daily newsletter is targeted at serious investors with a serious sense of humour and combines data-driven insights with straight-talking analysis.
Midlife Male is helping men maximize middle age. They're cutting through the crap to help males have happier, healthier, stronger lives and relationships.
Medallion Equine is the culmination of over 25 years' experience in equine nutrition. Through their flagship product, Optimize, their mission is to provide all horses with happier, healthier lives.

Creating is human. But for more than half of us, building, learning, making and crafting has historically been less accessible. Tools For Change is here to change that by engineering a more equitable future.
